Short, chin-length platinum white hair with a blunt fringe and smooth texture. Soft, almond-shaped pale grey eyes. Appears in the late teens with a youthful, mature face. Slender, athletic build. A short, high-collared black dress with white embroidery and a short black skirt. Features a black blindfold-like visor covering the upper half of the face and black thigh-high boots.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
